Name: Bara Anthro Alex
Author: RUBBERBARK
Description:
This is a simple mod to replace Alex's texture. Please note that this is a gay mod containing male sexual content.

After downloading the Generic Mod Config Menu, you can change the configuration in the game to use sexual content.

By default, Alex wear panties while weightlifting and on the beach. When you turn on all NSFW options, the portrait of Alex in the weightlifting plot will focus on displaying the penis, and Alex's beach portrait will also be the same (Alex's expression will correspond to different states of the penis, such as the erect penis in the portrait when Alex is happy).

In addition, I tried to modify the pictures of Alex and his mother in the beach memory plot to make them look like bears, but failed. I'm not sure what happened, and the pictures are currently in the folder.

I hope you have a wonderful gaming experience!
